description: Postal code field stored as int64 but intended as string type. Contains 30 distinct non-null values (100% unique) with no missing data. Values display inconsistent lengths of 4, 5, and 6 digits (range: 6907 to 786055), suggesting potential loss of leading zeros during numeric storage.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert data type from int64 to string to preserve leading zeros and prevent future format loss.
[CLARIFY] Confirm whether 4-digit and 5-digit values (e.g., 6907, 99999) should be left-padded with zeros to standardize to 6-digit postal codes, or if they represent valid exceptions.
